exact_source_text: Commitment — explicitly accept the plan; after commitment, strategic revision ends.

exact_source_text: Continuous Run — the party performs the complete passage as one embodied event.
authority_effect: Defines Continuous Run as performance of the complete passage as one embodied event.

exact_source_text: Resolution — determine global party outcome, individual adversity, and material consequences.
authority_effect: Defines Resolution as determination of global outcome, individual adversity, and material consequences.

exact_source_text: The road does not wait while the player takes turns.

exact_source_text: Any execution input expresses carrying out the chosen plan rather than creating a second strategic layer.
authority_effect: Clarifies that execution input carries out the chosen plan rather than creating a second strategic layer.

exact_source_text: An expedition party contains three body units.
authority_effect: Establishes that an expedition party contains three body units.

exact_source_text: Crossing therefore does not use waves, separate activations, or elaborate formations.

authority_effect: Defines execution staging as primarily through one foreground runner while remaining body units stay visible behind or adjacent.
